rows.label: Death Row Records
rows.hook: was the hip-hop powerhouse behind multi-platinum West Coast albums by Dr. Dre, Snoop Dogg and 2Pac

rows.label: Motown
rows.hook: was founded by Berry Gordy, its name a blend of the words motor and town

rows.label: Columbia Records
rows.description: American record label owned by Sony
rows.hook: is the oldest surviving brand name in the recorded sound business

rows.label: Def Jam Recordings
rows.hook: is a hip-hop-focused label that also specializes in contemporary R&B and soul

rows.label: Hybe
rows.hook: began life as Big Hit Entertainment before growing into a tech-driven lifestyle conglomerate

rows.label: Geffen Records
rows.hook: was founded by a mogul as a music arm of his film company, with backing from Warner Bros

rows.label: Interscope Records
rows.description: American record label based in California
rows.hook: is a major label owned by Universal Music Group, one of the world's biggest music companies

rows.label: JYP Entertainment
rows.hook: is a record label and talent agency run by a famous singer-producer, among the largest of its kind

rows.label: RCA Records
rows.hook: is a flagship Sony Music label, once the longtime rival of Columbia

rows.label: T-Series
rows.description: Indian music record label and film production company

rows.label: Roc Nation
rows.hook: was founded by Jay-Z as the successor to his earlier label, and also works as a talent agency

rows.label: SM Entertainment
rows.hook: was founded by Lee Soo-man and fostered many K-pop stars with huge global fanbases

rows.label: Republic Records

rows.label: OVO Sound

rows.label: Epic Records

rows.label: Sony Music
rows.hook: is the Japanese-owned recording division of a huge multinational conglomerate

rows.label: Island Records

rows.label: Young Money Entertainment
rows.hook: was founded by Lil Wayne as an imprint of a label billed as a billionaires collective

rows.label: Ruthless Records
rows.description: American record label founded by Eric "Eazy-E" Wright and Jerry Heller

rows.label: Virgin Records
rows.hook: was founded by Richard Branson and partners as an independent label before becoming a major

rows.label: Warner Records Inc.
rows.description: American record company; subsidiary of Warner Music Group
rows.hook: began as the recorded-music arm of a major Hollywood film studio

rows.label: EMI

rows.label: GOOD Music
